core.title: Modern Arched 15 Inch Shower Door Pulls, Pair, First Impressions FII-SD-3200/375

text.description_html:
First Impressions FII-SD-3200/375 14-3/4" Satin Nickel Modern Arched Shower Door Pulls

This modern shower door pull is constructed of durable non rusting aluminum.

Specifications of First Impressions SD-3200/375 Modern Arched Shower Door Pulls

  • Total Length: 14-3/4"
  • Mounting Center to Center: 11-13/16"
  • Non Rusting Aluminum
  • Finish: Satin Nickel

Packaged with 2 door pulls and includes all the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
